Rahul Gandhi's Indore event faces permit hurdles amid fee dispute

Preparations are underway for Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' event in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. The Indore Development Authority (IDA) has granted permission for the event, but with five specific conditions. The Madhya Pradesh Congress has accused the administration of imposing high fees and delaying the permit process. Congress media chief Mukesh Nayak drew a parallel to the era of Atal Bihari Vajpayee, criticizing the current administration's handling of the permission.
